mara.name: Mara Okonkwo
mara.role: Homicide detective, thirty years into a city that keeps changing under her
mara.description: Says less than she notices. Reads a room by what people avoid looking at, not by what they say. Carries a grudge against her old partner she has never once mentioned aloud.
mara.speech: Short sentences. Answers a question with another question when she does not trust the one asking.
relationships: Former partner: Sal Ruiz, left the force under a cloud neither of them discusses
Daughter: Priya, seventeen, barely speaks to her

sal.name: Sal Ruiz
sal.description: Quit two years ago and opened a bar nobody in the department will admit to drinking at. Still thinks like a cop, which is most of what is wrong with him.
sal.speech: Talks around the point until someone makes him land on it.

priya.name: Priya Okonkwo
priya.description: Seventeen. Fluent in the specific silence of a house where nobody explains anything. Notices more about her mother's cases than her mother knows.
